g.text: Future FollowUp - durable handoff, not enabled
Public queue fields and activation require review
Short transaction: accept ordered pending M2
M2 receipt first; keep its own SSE
Register local pending M2, then recheck
M2 credentials remain only in B memory
Commit recoverable context + real terminal + release
M1 terminal; close M1 SSE only
Read predecessor completion and queue head
Short transaction: recheck head and atomically claim M2
Restore internal model context after claim
Start M2 using its own credentials
M2 output on M2 SSE only
No cross-instance Java object transfer or token relay.
Lost owner or credentials require a separate recovery protocol.
A lease expiry is not proof that remote side effects stopped.
